assay: Tl+ flux: hTREK-1/CHO, HBSS + 20 mM HEPES (pH not stated), room temperature, compound alone 10 min then Tl+ (no activator stated: basal flux). QPatch and manual patch clamp (human, mouse): protocol, pH, temperature and activation not stated in the main text or the SI of this paper. value: Tl+ flux 0.26 | QPatch (SI Table S2) 0.15 | human manual patch clamp (text and abstract) 0.015 | mouse manual patch clamp (text) 0.067 | TREK-2 QPatch 0.17
relation: = (IC50). INCONSISTENCY: the paper states >67-fold selectivity, which equals 10 uM / 0.15 uM (the QPatch value); 15 nM would give >667-fold. The SI has no manual patch clamp TREK-1 value, so 15 nM versus 0.15 uM cannot be settled. GtoPdb carries 15 nM and labels it Rat; the paper says human
selectivity_panel_measured: K2P (SI Table S2): TREK-2 QPatch IC50 0.17 uM (equipotent); TASK-3 >10 uM (19 percent at 10 uM); TRESK >10 (26 percent); TWIK-2 >10 (13 percent); manual patch clamp at 10 uM: TRAAK -41 percent (activation), TASK-1 17 percent, TASK-2 7 percent. Cardiac manual patch clamp at 10 uM (SI Table S3): Cav1.2 -0.9, HCN4 0.6, Kir2.1 -1.1, Kir2.2 51.6 (transient), Kv1.5 2.4, Kv4.3/KChIP 2.1, KCNQ1/E1 47.3, Nav1.5 1.1, hERG 38.4 percent. Binding panel (Eurofins, 10 uM): A3 84 percent (Ki 0.48 uM), L-type Ca dihydropyridine 76 (Ki 0.54), L-type Ca benzothiazepine 56 (Ki 2.6), Na channel site 2 84 (Ki 0.65); hERG binding 39
not_tested: THIK-1, TALK, TASK-1 and TASK-3 beyond one concentration/IC50 above 10 uM; any heteromer; neuronal Kv (Kv2, Kv3, Kv7.2/7.3), Kir3, Kir6, neuronal Nav and Cav2/Cav3 subtypes; any concentration-response for TRAAK, TASK-1, TASK-2 (single 10 uM point); follow-up paper says compound 10 (a successor) inhibits TRAAK 84 and TASK-3 78 percent and that this is "similar to 5", which does not match the TRAAK activation and 19 percent TASK-3 in this SI (DECLARED, unresolved)
tested_at_more_than_one_pH: no (single condition; pH not stated for any channel assay; no pH series in the main text or SI)
neuronal_evidence: none in neurons or slices. In vivo only: male CD-1 mice, IP, 3.5 h before MK-801 0.2 mg/kg, novel object recognition, minimum effective dose 10 mg/kg (n = 15 per group). Mouse IP brain Cmax 888 nM total, 5.3 nM unbound (estimate from brain homogenate binding, authors call it a low estimate) against mouse manual patch clamp IC50 67 nM. Modified Irwin battery at 30 mg/kg IP in mice: scores near zero (SI Fig S3, 5-6 animals per group, read off a raster table)
alternative_actions: off-target binding above (A3, L-type Ca, Na channel site 2, Ki 0.48-2.6 uM, i.e. 3 to 17 fold above the QPatch TREK-1 IC50, arithmetic INFERENZA); TRAAK activation at 10 uM; TREK-2 equipotent; KCNQ1/E1 47 and hERG 38 percent at 10 uM; the follow-up paper reports that a regioisomer in the series switches from inhibitor to activator (class-level note, not for this compound)
